newsitem.title: USA: TransMontaigne to buy natural gas assets.
newsitem.headline: TransMontaigne to buy natural gas assets.

text.p: TransMontaigne Oil Co said Monday that a subsidiary has signed an agreement to buy all of the North Dakota and northeastern Montana natural gas assets from a division of Koch Industries Inc.
The cash transaction is between TransMontaigne's unit, Bear Paw Energy Inc, and Koch unit, Koch Hydrocarbon Co. The company did not disclose the value of the transaction.
The natural gas gathering, transmission and processing facilities consist of about 2,500 miles of various-sized pipelines and processing plants.
Koch is keeping its crude oil pipeline system and its exploration properties. The transaction is expected to close by January 31, 1997.
